description: Dual-Geometry Sentinel-1 SBAS-InSAR for Landslide-Related Deformation Mapping and InSAR-Informed Susceptibility Assessment in Tizi Ouzou, Northern Algeria is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. This repository provides the data products and processing code supporting the study “Dual-Geometry Sentinel-1 SBAS-InSAR for Landslide-Related Deformation Mapping and InSAR-Informed Susceptibility Assessment in Tizi Ouzou, Northern Algeria.” The archive includes the final deformation hotspot mask and hotspot-score raster, grouped hotspot polygons and summary tables, the compiled 98-point landslide inventory used for spatial-consistency assessment, benchmarking ... Coverage: Algeria. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
